title: Add support for official DVB 8K HEVC streams
description:
dvb.org has released official [HEVC 8K test files](https://dvb.org/specifications/verification-validation/hevc-test-content/) : DVB_7680x4320_HEVC_50fps_HLG10.ts and DVB_7680x4320_HEVC_50fps_PQ10.ts.
I made some bug fixes, also added and extended MPEG TS descriptors (0x48 
and 0x50) according to EN300468 1.16.1 and 1.17.1 both to be able to parse 
them and UHD (4K) streams also.
Unfortunately, a fresh EN300468 specification has not been released yet.
So a full amount of changes will come with it later. It will be unknown
0x38 descriptor and additional content codes, higher and equal than
stream_content_ext = 0x00, stream_content = 0x09, content_type = 0x08.
